topic: Can satellite orbital configurations optimize ML-based QoS by reducing propagation delays for latency-sensitive traffic classes?
response: Satellite orbital configurations can reduce propagation delays. Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites have lower latency (~20-30 ms) compared to Geostationary Orbit (GEO) satellites (~240-280 ms), optimizing ML-based QoS for latency-sensitive traffic.
reference_context: High fixed latencies on satellite links negatively impact QoS, requiring consideration of link characteristics in path selection mechanisms for converged satellite and terrestrial networks.
